blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — An approximately 80-kilogram female green sea turtle, locally known as pawikan, was released into its natural habitat by the city government of Candon in this province as part of its Pawikan Development Project. In a statement on Tuesday (Nov. 3), the city government, led by Mayor Eric Dario Singson, said the release was facilitated by the City Agriculture Office, headed by Eric Gacutan, in coordination with the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) and the Philippine Coast Guard.
